title: Team Collaboration Switch v1
description: The A/B switch for the three proactive-collaboration mechanisms (intent before implement, formal assumptions, decision log). Default "off" reproduces today's behaviour byte for byte.

collab.description: off = no new tools, no guard, no snapshot block (current behaviour). on = intent guard, team_assume, team_decision, and the dependency-filtered decision block in the pre-step snapshot.

decisionLimit.description: How many recent decisions of dependency-related teammates the snapshot carries. Trimmed further whenever the snapshot budget would be exceeded.

assumptionDeadline.description: Deadline attached to the delivery a team_assume raise makes to the owner it names.
